name: @markdown-viewer/image-size
description: Local drop-in for the `image-size` package: reads width/height for the image formats remark-docx can embed (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, SVG). Wired in through the `image-size` alias in vite.config.ts and vitest.config.ts; the registry package itself is replaced by an empty stub via `overrides` in the root package.json.
